python - << 'PY'
from astropy.table import Table
from io import StringIO
import astropy.units as u
s='''Title:
Authors:
Table:
================================================================================
Byte-by-byte Description of file: tab.txt
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Bytes Format Units           \t\tLabel      Explanations
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   1- 10 A10    ---            \t\tID         ID
  12- 21 F10.5  10+3J/m/s/kpc2     \tSBCONT     Cont surface brightness
  23- 32 F10.5  10-7J/s/kpc2 \t\tSBLINE     Line surface brightness
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
ID0001     70.99200   38.51040      
ID0001     13.05120   28.19240      
ID0001     3.83610    10.98370      
ID0001     1.99101    6.78822       
ID0001     1.31142    5.01932      
'''
t=Table.read(s, format='ascii.cds')
print(t)
print(t['SBCONT'].unit, t['SBLINE'].unit)
# Validate equivalence
u1 = u.Unit('10+3J/m/s/kpc2', format='cds')
u2 = t['SBCONT'].unit
print('Equivalent SBCONT?', (u1 == u2))
u3 = u.Unit('10-7J/s/kpc2', format='cds')
print('Equivalent SBLINE?', (u3 == t['SBLINE'].unit))
PY
